text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lara, I'm glad I ran into you. Happy 
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, Ai-san. You came all this way just to 
let me know? I'm so happy, thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing, really. More importantly, 
I've prepared a present for you... May I 
bring it to your room?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My room? Is it somethin' so big ya can't 
hand it over directly? Wonder what it is. 
I'm gettin' all excited!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You often talk about taking center stage 
like a 'star flower', so fittingly... I 
prepared a whole bunch of flowers for you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! Ai-san, you went and 
thought about me like that, did ya?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad. How should I pay ya back? 
Maybe actions speak louder than a gift 
here?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're wishin' for me to become 
the star of the show, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I had a feeling you'd say that. Yes, I 
do wish for it. If it's even possible, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
An easy path would be unacceptable. That's 
why—just for today, I'll present you with 
this bouquet.
